description: Convert one CSS absolute length. An inch is 96px and 2.54 cm, so a centimetre is 4800/127 px, a millimetre is 480/127 px, and Q (a quarter-millimetre) is 120/127 px. A point is 4/3 px and a pica is 16px. Units: px, in, cm, mm, Q, pt, pc. em, rem, percent and viewport units are rejected. Exact rationals, 12 decimal places. Returns JSON with: value, unit, px, pxFraction, in, inFraction, cm, cmFraction. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/css-length
